arxiv-2105-14672.title: Origin of band flatness and constraints of higher Chern numbers
arxiv-2105-14672.creator: Alexander Kruchkov
arxiv-2105-14672.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Alexander Kruchkov. Flat bands provide a natural platform for emergent electronic states beyond Landau paradigm. Among those of particular importance are flat Chern bands, including bands of higher Chern numbers ( C C > > 1 1 ). We introduce a new framework for band flatness through wave functions , and classify the existing isolated flat bands in a ”periodic table” according to tight binding features and wave function properties.

arxiv-2108-07530.title: Generation of plasma electron halo by charged particle beam in low density plasma
arxiv-2108-07530.creator: K.V. Lotov
arxiv-2108-07530.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by K.V. Lotov. Breaking of a plasma wave driven by a long beam of charged particles results in electron jets escaping from the plasma column and forming an electron halo. For plasma densities less than or of the order of the beam density, this process is well described by a semi-analytical model, which agrees with simulations and allows to calculate the position of wavebreaking points and determine the regions around the plasma column occupied by the halo.

arxiv-2201-09479.title: Constraining the baryon loading factor of AGN jets: implication from the gamma-ray emission of the Coma cluster
arxiv-2201-09479.creator: Xin-Yue Shi 1,2 , Yi Zhang 1,2 , Ruo-Yu Liu 1,2 and Xiang-Yu Wang 1,2
arxiv-2201-09479.description: Abstract High-energy cosmic rays (CRs) can be accelerated in the relativistic jets of Active Galactic Nuclei (AGNs) powered by supermassive black holes. The baryon loading efficiency onto relativistic CR baryons from the accreting black holes is poorly constrained by observations so far.

arxiv-2210-00092.title: Federated Training of Dual Encoding Models on Small Non-IID Client Datasets
arxiv-2210-00092.creator: Raviteja Vemulapalli, Warren Richard Morningstar, Philip Andrew Mansfield
arxiv-2210-00092.description: Abstract Dual encoding models that encode a pair of inputs are widely used for representation learning. Many approaches train dual encoding models by maximizing agreement between pairs of encodings on centralized training data. However, in many scenarios, datasets are inherently decentralized across many clients, motivating federated learning.

arxiv-2310-14023.title: Search for narrow trijet resonances in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2310-14023.description: Abstract The first search for singly produced narrow resonances decaying to three well-separated hadronic jets is presented. The search uses proton-proton collision data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV , collected at the CERN LHC. No significant deviations from the background predictions are observed between 1.75 and 9.00 \TeV .

arxiv-2310-19037.title: Spherically Symmetric Configurations in Unimodular Gravity
arxiv-2310-19037.creator: Júlio C. Fabris, Mahamadou Hamani Daouda, Hermano Velten
arxiv-2310-19037.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Júlio C. Fabris, Mahamadou Hamani Daouda, Hermano Velten. Unimodular gravity (UG) is considered, under many aspects, equivalent to General Relativity (GR), even if the theory is invariant under a more restricted diffeomorphic class of transformations. We discuss the conditions for the equivalence between the two formulations by applying the UG to the static and spherically symmetric configurations being the energy-momentum tensor sourced by a scalar field or by the electromagnetic field.

arxiv-2312-11798.title: Fracture process of composite material in a spring network model
arxiv-2312-11798.creator: Haruka Noguchi and Satoshi Yukawa
arxiv-2312-11798.description: Abstract We analyze a two-dimensional spring network model comprising breakable and unbreakable springs. Computer simulations showed this system to exhibit intermittent stress drops in a larger strain regime, and these stress drops resulted in ductile-like behavior. The scaling analysis reveals that the avalanche size distribution demonstrates a cut-off, depending on its internal structure.

arxiv-2402-12258.title: Low-mass Runaways from the Orion Nebula Cluster - Kinematic Age Constraints on Star Cluster Formation 2024 Low-mass Runaways from the Orion Nebula Cluster - Kinematic Age Constraints on Star Cluster Formation – 10
arxiv-2402-12258.creator: Muhammad Fajrin, Joseph J. Armstrong, Jonathan C. Tan, Juan P. Farias, and Laurent Eyer
arxiv-2402-12258.description: Abstract In their early, formative stages star clusters can undergo rapid dynamical evolution leading to strong gravitational interactions and ejection of “runaway” stars at high velocities. While O/B runaway stars have been well studied, lower-mass runaways are so far very poorly characterised, even though they are expected to be much more common.
